content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Allentown

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Document your work history, education, and any formal project-management training. Verify you meet these baseline requirements before enrolling in the bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere, covering the full PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application. Your completion certificate documents the required contact hours for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After bootcamp completion, submit your formal PMP application to PMI through their online portal. Include your education, project-management experience, and bootcamp completion certificate. Pay the PMI exam fee and await approval—typically granted within days.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor support, to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your computer-based exam at a PMI-approved testing center. The exam tests your mastery of project-management knowledge and competency.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Pursue PDUs through training, conferences, volunteer work, or reading. Renew by submitting your PDU record and renewal fee to PMI before expiration.
